title: CS1 uninvigilated programming lab tests
summary: Students complete two timed, uninvigilated CS1 programming tests in CodeRunner, submitting function solutions against automated tests. The paper evaluated how readily Codex could solve these authentic assessments, indicating their exposure to direct AI-generated solutions rather than reporting permitted student AI use.

sources.title: My AI Wants to Know if This Will Be on the Exam: Testing OpenAI’s Codex on CS2 Programming Exercises

assessment.summary: Solve 28 introductory programming questions across two two-hour lab tests.
student_actions: Write code for each programming problem.
Run visible tests and resubmit solutions when needed.

student_role.description: Codex was tested offline on the student-facing questions; the source does not report an AI-use policy for students.

grading.method: CodeRunner awarded all-or-nothing marks for passing all tests and applied resubmission penalties up to 50%.
